hook.line: What if I told you I got businesses recommended by AI without doing anything for AI?
hook.visual: Man seated in a bright living room, wide shot, hands clasped; white-on-black caption types out letter by letter with a block cursor mid-frame.

beats.what: Opens on the paradox: AI recommendations without any AI work, typed out in the caption
Proof: websites for an electrician and a barber shop showed up in ChatGPT and Gemini
Reveal: 'nothing fancy', just well-structured sites explaining what they do and where
Step two: consistent business info across directories like Google Business Profile, Apple Maps, Yelp
Step three: genuinely useful content for customers
Jab at SEO agencies selling an 'extra AI thing'; get the fundamentals right
Warning that a messy web presence falls further behind as AI search changes
Closing line: build a presence worth recommending, key words in yellow

why_it_works: Contradicts the viewer's expectation in the first sentence (AI results with no AI work), so they stay for the reveal
Two named real clients (electrician, barber shop) make the claim feel tested, not theoretical
Typewriter caption with a cursor keeps text moving on a static shot, giving the eye something to follow at 3.56 words/s
weaknesses: One 66 s shot with no cuts, zooms or events; wide framing makes the face small (0.156 of frame height)
No screenshot of the ChatGPT or Gemini result he claims, so the proof stays verbal
No follow, comment or link ask at the end
for_robert: Use the 'result without the expected work' opener and back it with the screenshot this video lacks, e.g. Fred holding up the ChatGPT answer; avoid a wide static frame for over a minute.
